Larger-font editor wraps explanatory text, preserves labels/fields and accessible Check/Insert/Cancel footer. Unknown/newly invalidated review does not permit insertion.
Larger-font geometry and mounting heading/status are readable as distinct lines. Local20 does not become mounting approval; fixed footer remains fully visible.
